title: games
description: i absolutely love video games! it's my favourite form of entertainment and escapism, though i prefer to watch gameplays from my favourite youtubers rather than play the games myself. there is a game i do play consistently: Genshin Impact! Genshin Impact is an open-world adventure RPG that features a variety of characters with different play styles. i started playing the game a few weeks after it released (2020), and have been playing it ever since! this game is near and dear to my heart because it holds many fond memories of mine. other favourites of mine include Detroit: Become Human, Omori, Persona 5, Ace Attorney series, Bendy and the Ink Machine series, Five Nights at Freddy's series, AI: The Somnium Files series, The Quarry, and many more!

images.imgDescription: 'Wherever you go, whatever life throws at you... In Teyvat, the stars in the sky will always have a place for you.'
Kaeya was my first favourite character and main in 'Genshin Impact'! I love his voice and design, so perfect !!
This random photo I took of Clorinde because she matched the flowers in the bushes... lmao-
This shot makes Lumine look so silly in this picture with Flins, haha!
Back when Flins wasn't a playable character yet, I always took photos with him whenever he showed up. This is one of them, with Skirk !!
Sandrone and Columbina were a duo I never expected to love, but I adored their interactions together, so cute !!
'Yep, my best friend. The one I was looking for. I never thought I'd actually get to see her again. I'm just... so happy.' - Columbina, about Sandrone.
Ah, Nicole !! I love this photo of her, she's such a cutie! I remember being so shocked but happy when I got her in a single wish!
'No, I don't. I just... I have a feeling that he might be dangerous.' - Odette, about Mitya.
'Wherever you go, whatever life throws at you... In Teyvat, the stars in the sky will always have a place for you.'

title: art
description: digital art is my passion! i wouldn't call myself the most amazing artist, especially since my drawings are relatively simple and cartoony, but i love drawing for myself whenever i can! it all started when i got my first ipad and one of those pens with a stylus tip. i remember how clumsy i was and how strange it felt to draw on a different surface, but i would learn and experiment by drawing characters from whatever game i was interested in at the time. eventually, i managed to refine my art style to what it is now thanks to my little sister's ipad pencil, which i would borrow often when she wasn't using it. i actually designed and drew the graphics for this website myself using ibisPaint X, my go-to art program!

images.imgDescription: When the android sent by CyberLife likes dogs-
'Why do you look like a fluorescent shrimp?' - Date, about Aiba's humanoid form.
I remember enjoying this game so much; to the point where I drew a lot of fanart for 'AI: The Somnium Files'. This drawing is of Iris and Mizuki!
I was obsessed with Ushio's 'Boyfriend of the Dead'; so much so that I drew and worked on fanarts for the webtoon nearly every day!
'For better or for worse, you are gonna stick with me!' - Alex, about N.

Ah, 'Bendy and the Ink Machine'... If I'm remembering it right, I'm pretty sure it was for this game that I started drawing digitally for the first time! I believe it was Alice Angel I drew when I first learned to draw on my iPad.
Boris !! He's my favourite of the trio!
...Whenever I think about 'Bendy and the Ink Machine', there's always a sense of cozy nostalgia about it, even with its horror aspects.

One of my beloved characters! ...Okay, so she's basically another version of me that can rock a ponytail (I don't even have long hair or bangs) AND cute outfits. ...I don't even know how, she just spawned in my head all those years ago! Of all my characters, I've drawn her the most!

All illusory guides are my beloved characters! ...They've existed for as long as my first character (previous image/Guide 777), but this is the first time I've drawn them. Before the garden's creation, 111 and 222 were the first characters (excluding 777) I drew full-body!

title: vtubers
description: the world of vtubers was something i discovered on accident, but i'm so glad i got into this rabbit hole because they're so entertaining! vtubers, or virtual youtubers, are online entertainers who stream using animated, rigged virtual avatars rather than using their real-life identity. i found it to be such an intriguing concept when i accidentally stumbled on a vtuber's channel while looking for songs, which led me to watch them out of curiosity. eventually, i learned that the first ever vtuber i stumbled upon was under a vtuber agency called Nijisanji. from there, i've been watching Nijisanji livers for their gameplay, music, collabs, and more!

images.imgDescription: Life certainly felt brighter when I found Finana Ryugu's debut song, 'Tsunami'! The song was produced by my favourite artist, KIRA, which is how I discovered NIJISANJI EN!

NIJISANJI EN's fifth wave, Noctyx, is my favourite wave !! This wave solidified my interests in vtubing, so I'm quite fond of them, even if my favourite liver within the wave left a while ago. #Nocturnal forever!
Haha, this is a fanart of Uki Violeta and Fulgur Ovid I drew a while ago. I love all livers within Noctyx, but I watched Fulgur and Uki's livestreams/videos more often!
NIJISANJI EN's eleventh wave, BY THE BEAT, became another one of my favourite waves when I started watching vtubers again !! 'True to heart, we are BY THE BEAT!' #Hzbeats forever!

title: web development
description: i remember being uncertain about what i wanted to do after i finish university, until i decided to take a human-computer interaction course and an introduction to web development course. as someone who likes to draw, i learned that i do adore designing user interfaces and implementing them, which i got to do in the two mentioned classes. the projects i got to do in the web development classes showed me how difficult yet satisfying it could be to design websites! my interest in web development solidified further when i had an exciting opportunity to work as a web developer as part of my co-op education. now, i'm looking forward to learning more about web development in the hopes that i can work in this industry!

images.imgDescription: I was excited when I got to implement a brand new page for Shift AI's website! I designed some simple prototypes in FigJam, and the image here is one of them!
The final, live version of Shift AI's Hardware page. I remember feeling so proud and excited when I implemented this page !!
When I first thought of creating a website, I drew some rough designs in ibisPaint X. This was the first rough design I had in mind!

A few months or so passed after the first rough design of the website; by that point, I couldn't work on it because I got busy. When I finally had the chance to work on my website again, I decided to adjust the design and the theme. This was the second rough design I had in mind, which I used in my prototype!

After my experiences with designing prototypes in Figma, I decided to implement the prototype for my 'garden of dreams' in Figma as well! Figma is a lifesaver, especially with adjusting and editing images.
